capabilities: Update and refresh the status of an SVN working copy
View a change tree of added, modified, deleted, conflicted, untracked and missing files
Stage, unstage and restore individual files or folders
Commit staged changes with an automatically generated summary
Detect conflicts, show an indicator and mark them resolved
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; not available on mobile. Manual install from release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). Uses Node.js child_process and fs permissions, which the README flags explicitly. Not distributed via the community plugin store per the README instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in SVN support, so users must switch to a terminal or external client to update, stage and commit vault changes.
summary: Visual SVN client panel that manages SVN working copies inside the vault with status tree, staging, commits and conflict resolution.
